text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no thermal detections recorded within the property during the period from 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-26. All sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the area every day of this period. However, it's important to note that this does not guarantee that no fires occurred, as small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected.
